title: Account creation
description: As a visitor, I want to create an account so that I can start using the platform.
constraints: The email address must be unique.
The password must contain at least 8 characters.
Required fields must be validated before submission.
A confirmation message must be shown after successful registration.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a valid registration form, when the user submits it, then the account is created.
Given an email already in use, when the user submits the form, then an error message is displayed.
Given an incomplete form, when the user submits it, then the submission is blocked.

title: Email verification
description: As a new user, I want to verify my email so that I can activate my account.
constraints: The verification link must be unique.
The link must expire after a limited duration.
The account must remain inactive until verification is completed.
A clear message must be displayed if the link is invalid.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a valid verification link, when the user opens it, then the account is activated.
Given an expired link, when the user opens it, then they are prompted to request a new one.
Given an already verified account, when the link is reused, then an informative message is displayed.

title: Resend verification email
description: As a user, I want to resend the verification email so that I can activate my account if I did not receive the first message.
constraints: The resend action must be available only to unverified users.
Multiple resend requests must be rate limited.
A generic success message must be displayed to avoid account enumeration.
The email must contain the latest valid verification link.
acceptanceCriteria: Given an unverified account, when the user requests a resend, then a verification email is sent.
Given a verified account, when the user requests a resend, then the action is unavailable.
Given repeated requests, when the limit is reached, then the user is informed to try later.

title: Change password
description: As a logged-in user, I want to change my password so that I can keep my account secure.
constraints: The current password must be required.
The new password must follow the security policy.
The new password must differ from the current one.
A success message must be displayed after the change.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a valid current password and compliant new password, when the form is submitted, then the password is updated.
Given an incorrect current password, when the form is submitted, then the update is rejected.
Given a weak new password, when the form is submitted, then validation errors are displayed.

title: Remember me
description: As a user, I want to stay signed in on my device so that I do not need to log in again every time.
constraints: The session duration must increase only when the option is selected.
The feature must not be enabled on public devices by default.
The user must be able to revoke remembered devices from account settings.
Security controls must still apply to protected actions.
acceptanceCriteria: Given the option is selected, when the user logs in, then a persistent session is created.
Given the option is not selected, when the user closes the browser, then the session expires normally.
Given a revoked device, when it tries to access the account, then it must be prompted to log in again.

title: Two-factor authentication activation
description: As a user, I want to enable two-factor authentication so that my account is better protected.
constraints: A valid mobile number or authenticator app must be configured.
The setup process must include a verification step.
Backup codes must be generated once activation is complete.
The user must be able to cancel the setup before confirmation.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a valid setup flow, when the user confirms the code, then two-factor authentication is enabled.
Given an invalid code, when the user submits it, then the setup is rejected.
Given the activation is cancelled, when the user exits the flow, then no changes are saved.

title: Two-factor authentication login
description: As a user with two-factor authentication enabled, I want to enter a second code during login so that I can securely access my account.
constraints: The second factor must be requested after valid credentials are entered.
The code must expire after a limited duration.
Too many invalid attempts must temporarily block verification.
The user must be able to request a new code.
acceptanceCriteria: Given valid credentials, when the second code is correct, then the user is logged in.
Given an invalid second code, when it is submitted, then access is denied.
Given an expired code, when it is submitted, then the user is asked to request a new one.

title: View dashboard
description: As a logged-in user, I want to view my dashboard so that I can quickly see key information.
constraints: The dashboard must be accessible only to authenticated users.
Loading placeholders must be shown while data is being fetched.
Displayed metrics must come from the official data source.
Sensitive details must not be shown on the dashboard.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a logged-in user, when they open the dashboard, then the main summary is displayed.
Given a data loading failure, when the dashboard loads, then an error state is shown.
Given a logged-out user, when they access the page, then they are redirected to login.

title: Update avatar
description: As a logged-in user, I want to update my profile picture so that my account looks personalized.
constraints: The image file must have an allowed format.
The file size must not exceed the configured limit.
A preview must be displayed before saving.
The previous avatar must remain unchanged if the upload fails.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a valid image, when the user saves it, then the avatar is updated.
Given an unsupported file type, when the user uploads it, then validation errors are shown.
Given a failed upload, when the user retries, then the previous avatar stays visible.

title: Delete account
description: As a user, I want to delete my account so that I can remove my data from the platform.
constraints: The user must confirm the action before deletion.
A re-authentication step must be required for safety.
Associated personal data must be handled according to retention rules.
The action must be irreversible once completed.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a confirmed request, when the user validates deletion, then the account is removed.
Given an incorrect password during confirmation, when the user submits it, then deletion is blocked.
Given a cancelled confirmation, when the dialog is closed, then no account changes occur.

title: Export personal data
description: As a user, I want to export my personal data so that I can keep a copy of the information stored about me.
constraints: The export must include only the user's own data.
The file must be generated in a readable format.
A secure download link must be provided.
The link must expire after a limited duration.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a valid request, when the export is generated, then the user can download the file.
Given a failed generation, when the request is processed, then an error message is displayed.
Given an expired download link, when it is used, then access is denied.

title: Manage notification preferences
description: As a user, I want to configure notification preferences so that I receive only relevant alerts.
constraints: Preferences must be saved per user account.
Each notification channel must be independently configurable.
The default settings must be visible on first visit.
Changes must persist after the user logs out.
acceptanceCriteria: Given updated preferences, when the user saves them, then the new settings are stored.
Given invalid changes, when the user submits the form, then validation messages are displayed.
Given a reopened settings page, when it loads, then the saved preferences are displayed.

title: Enable email notifications
description: As a user, I want to enable email notifications so that I am informed about important activity.
constraints: The email address must be verified before activation.
The user must be able to unsubscribe at any time.
Notification frequency must respect user settings.
A confirmation message must be displayed after activation.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a verified email address, when the user enables the option, then email notifications are activated.
Given an unverified address, when the user enables the option, then they are prompted to verify first.
Given a disabled option, when the user saves changes, then no email notifications are sent.

title: Disable email notifications
description: As a user, I want to disable email notifications so that I stop receiving unwanted emails.
constraints: The change must take effect immediately after saving.
Transactional security emails must remain enabled.
The user must receive a confirmation of the update.
The preference must be honored on future events.
acceptanceCriteria: Given enabled email notifications, when the user disables them, then marketing emails stop.
Given the setting is already disabled, when the page loads, then the state is shown correctly.
Given a successful update, when the user refreshes the page, then the saved state persists.

title: Search user records
description: As an admin user, I want to search user records so that I can find a specific account quickly.
constraints: The search must support email and name fields.
Results must be limited to authorized records.
No result state must be displayed when nothing matches.
The search query must be sanitized before execution.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a valid query, when the admin searches, then matching records are listed.
Given no matches, when the admin searches, then an empty state is shown.
Given an unauthorized user, when they access search, then access is denied.

title: Filter activity log
description: As an admin user, I want to filter the activity log so that I can review relevant events.
constraints: Filters must support date range and event type.
Results must update without losing the current filters.
Only permitted users can access the log.
The loading state must be visible while results are fetched.
acceptanceCriteria: Given selected filters, when the admin applies them, then the log is updated.
Given a cleared filter set, when the admin resets filters, then all visible events are restored.
Given an unauthorized access attempt, when the page is opened, then access is blocked.

title: View audit trail
description: As an admin user, I want to view the audit trail so that I can trace changes made in the system.
constraints: Audit records must include the actor, action, and timestamp.
Records must be immutable.
Only authorized roles can access the trail.
Pagination must be available for large volumes.
acceptanceCriteria: Given an authorized admin, when they open the audit trail, then recent records are displayed.
Given a large dataset, when the admin navigates pages, then records load correctly.
Given a modification attempt, when an audit record is edited, then the operation is rejected.

title: Create address
description: As a logged-in user, I want to add an address so that I can use it for delivery or billing.
constraints: Required address fields must be validated.
The postal code must follow the local format.
One address can be marked as primary.
A success message must be displayed after saving.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a valid address form, when the user saves it, then the address is created.
Given missing required fields, when the form is submitted, then validation errors are shown.
Given a server error, when saving fails, then the entered data remains visible.

title: Edit address
description: As a logged-in user, I want to edit an address so that I can keep it accurate.
constraints: The address must belong to the current user.
Validation rules must be applied before saving.
A failure must not erase the entered data.
The updated address must replace the previous one in the list.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a valid update, when the user saves it, then the address details are changed.
Given invalid data, when the form is submitted, then the user sees validation errors.
Given an unauthorized attempt, when the user edits another account's address, then access is denied.

title: Delete address
description: As a logged-in user, I want to delete an address so that I can remove old delivery details.
constraints: The user must confirm the deletion.
A primary address cannot be deleted without first selecting another primary address.
The deletion must be reflected immediately in the address list.
An error message must be shown if the operation fails.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a confirmed deletion, when the user validates it, then the address is removed.
Given a primary address with no replacement, when the user tries to delete it, then the action is blocked.
Given a failed request, when the deletion cannot be completed, then the address remains visible.

title: Set primary address
description: As a user, I want to set a primary address so that the system can use it by default.
constraints: Only one address can be primary at a time.
The selected address must belong to the user.
The change must persist across sessions.
A confirmation should be displayed after saving.
acceptanceCriteria: Given several saved addresses, when the user selects one as primary, then it becomes the default.
Given a different address already marked primary, when the change is saved, then the old one is unset.
Given an invalid address selection, when the user submits it, then the request is rejected.

title: View orders
description: As a customer, I want to view my orders so that I can track my purchases.
constraints: Orders must be sorted by most recent first.
Only the current user's orders may be displayed.
Each order must show its status and date.
A loading state must be visible before results appear.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a logged-in customer, when they open orders, then their order list is displayed.
Given no orders, when the page loads, then an empty state is shown.
Given a logged-out user, when they access the page, then they are redirected to login.

title: View order details
description: As a customer, I want to view order details so that I can check the contents and status of a specific order.
constraints: Only the owner of the order can access it.
The detail page must show line items and totals.
Sensitive payment data must be masked.
An error state must be displayed if the order cannot be found.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a valid order ID, when the customer opens it, then the full order details are shown.
Given an unknown order ID, when the page is opened, then a not-found message is displayed.
Given an unauthorized request, when the user accesses another order, then access is denied.

title: Download invoice
description: As a customer, I want to download an invoice so that I can keep a proof of purchase.
constraints: Only completed orders may generate an invoice.
The invoice must include the order number and billing details.
The document must be generated in a downloadable format.
The download link must be secure and time limited.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a completed order, when the customer requests an invoice, then the file is generated.
Given an incomplete order, when the customer requests an invoice, then the action is unavailable.
Given an expired link, when it is opened, then access to the invoice is denied.

title: Cancel order
description: As a customer, I want to cancel an order so that I can stop a purchase before it is processed.
constraints: Only cancellable orders may be cancelled.
The user must confirm the cancellation.
The system must update the order status immediately.
A refund message must be shown when applicable.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a cancellable order, when the customer confirms cancellation, then the status changes to cancelled.
Given an already shipped order, when the customer tries to cancel it, then the action is blocked.
Given a successful cancellation, when the page refreshes, then the new status is visible.

title: Track shipment
description: As a customer, I want to track my shipment so that I can see the delivery progress.
constraints: The tracking number must be available before tracking begins.
The shipment status must be refreshed from the carrier system.
The page must handle missing or invalid tracking numbers.
A loading indicator must be shown while data is fetched.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a valid tracking number, when the customer opens the tracking page, then shipment progress is displayed.
Given an invalid tracking number, when it is submitted, then an error message is shown.
Given no tracking data, when the page loads, then the customer is informed that the shipment is pending.

title: Add payment method
description: As a customer, I want to add a payment method so that I can save it for future purchases.
constraints: Card details must be validated before saving.
Sensitive payment data must be tokenized.
The payment method must be associated with the current user only.
A confirmation must be shown after successful addition.
acceptanceCriteria: Given valid card details, when the customer saves them, then the payment method is added.
Given invalid card details, when the form is submitted, then validation errors are displayed.
Given a payment gateway error, when saving fails, then no card data is stored.

title: Edit payment method
description: As a customer, I want to update a payment method so that my saved details remain current.
constraints: Only editable fields may be changed.
The payment token must remain secure.
Expired cards must be flagged by validation rules.
The user must see a success message after saving.
acceptanceCriteria: Given valid edits, when the customer saves them, then the payment method is updated.
Given expired card data, when the customer submits it, then validation fails.
Given a failed update, when the request cannot be completed, then the existing payment method remains unchanged.

title: Delete payment method
description: As a customer, I want to delete a payment method so that I can remove old card details.
constraints: The primary payment method cannot be removed if it is the only one available.
The user must confirm deletion.
Card data must be removed from the customer profile.
A clear error message must be shown if deletion fails.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a saved payment method, when the customer confirms deletion, then it is removed.
Given the only payment method, when the customer tries to delete it, then the action is blocked.
Given a failed request, when deletion cannot be completed, then the method remains listed.

title: Subscribe to newsletter
description: As a visitor, I want to subscribe to the newsletter so that I can receive product updates.
constraints: A valid email address must be required.
The user must explicitly accept the subscription conditions.
A confirmation email must be sent after subscription.
The unsubscribe option must remain available in each email.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a valid email address, when the visitor subscribes, then the subscription is created.
Given an invalid email address, when the form is submitted, then validation errors are displayed.
Given a duplicate subscription, when the visitor submits again, then a friendly message is shown.

title: Unsubscribe from newsletter
description: As a subscriber, I want to unsubscribe from the newsletter so that I stop receiving marketing emails.
constraints: The unsubscribe link must work without login.
The request must be processed quickly.
A confirmation page must be shown after completion.
Transactional emails must not be affected.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a valid unsubscribe link, when the user opens it, then the subscription is cancelled.
Given an expired link, when it is opened, then the user is asked to request a new one.
Given a successful unsubscribe, when future campaigns are sent, then the user does not receive them.

title: View notifications
description: As a user, I want to view my notifications so that I can stay informed about important events.
constraints: Only the current user's notifications may be displayed.
Unread notifications must be visually distinguishable.
A loading state must appear while notifications are fetched.
The list must support pagination or infinite scroll.
acceptanceCriteria: Given unread notifications, when the user opens the panel, then they are displayed first.
Given no notifications, when the panel opens, then an empty state is shown.
Given a logged-out user, when they try to access notifications, then access is denied.

title: Mark notifications as read
description: As a user, I want to mark notifications as read so that I can keep my inbox organized.
constraints: The unread count must update immediately.
Only the selected user's notifications can be updated.
The action must work for single and bulk selection.
A failure message must be shown if the update fails.
acceptanceCriteria: Given unread notifications, when the user marks one as read, then the unread count decreases.
Given multiple selected notifications, when the user marks them as read, then all are updated.
Given a failed update, when the request cannot be completed, then the notification state remains unchanged.

title: Clear notifications
description: As a user, I want to clear notifications so that I can remove old alerts from my list.
constraints: Only the current user's notifications may be cleared.
The user must confirm bulk deletion.
The notification count must update after clearing.
Important system alerts may be excluded according to policy.
acceptanceCriteria: Given selected notifications, when the user confirms clearing, then the list is updated.
Given a cancellation, when the dialog is dismissed, then no notifications are deleted.
Given a server error, when clearing fails, then the notifications remain visible.

title: View favorites
description: As a user, I want to view my favorites so that I can quickly access saved items.
constraints: Only the user's own favorites must be shown.
Items must be ordered by the user's sorting preference or most recent addition.
A loading state must be visible during retrieval.
The page must handle empty results gracefully.
acceptanceCriteria: Given saved favorites, when the user opens the page, then their favorite items are listed.
Given no favorites, when the page loads, then an empty state is shown.
Given a logged-out user, when they access the page, then they are redirected to login.

title: Add favorite
description: As a user, I want to add an item to favorites so that I can find it later.
constraints: The item must not already be in favorites.
Only accessible items can be favorited.
The action must be available from the item detail page and list view.
A confirmation indicator must appear after saving.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a valid item, when the user adds it to favorites, then it appears in the favorites list.
Given an already favorited item, when the user clicks the action again, then no duplicate is created.
Given an unauthorized item, when the user attempts to favorite it, then the action is blocked.

title: Remove favorite
description: As a user, I want to remove an item from favorites so that I can keep the list relevant.
constraints: The item must be removed from the user's list only.
The action must be reversible only by adding it again.
The UI must update immediately after removal.
An error message must be displayed if the request fails.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a favorited item, when the user removes it, then it disappears from the list.
Given a non-favorited item, when the user clicks remove, then the action is ignored or hidden.
Given a failed request, when removal cannot be completed, then the item remains in favorites.

title: Language selection
description: As a user, I want to choose my language so that the application is easier to use.
constraints: Supported languages must be listed in the settings.
The choice must persist across sessions.
Fallback text must be shown for unsupported content.
The change must apply without breaking the current page.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a supported language, when the user selects it, then the interface updates accordingly.
Given a saved preference, when the user returns later, then the same language is used.
Given an unsupported translation key, when the page loads, then the default language is displayed.

title: Theme selection
description: As a user, I want to switch between light and dark themes so that I can use the application comfortably.
constraints: The selected theme must be saved per user or device preference.
The switch must update the interface immediately.
The default theme must follow system settings when available.
The toggle must remain accessible on all main pages.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a selected theme, when the user changes it, then the interface updates instantly.
Given a saved preference, when the user returns, then the same theme is applied.
Given a system preference, when no explicit choice exists, then the app follows the system theme.

title: Change username
description: As a user, I want to change my username so that my account reflects my preferred display name.
constraints: The username must be unique if the system requires uniqueness.
Special characters must be validated according to policy.
A success message must be shown after saving.
The old username must remain unchanged if the update fails.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a valid username, when the user submits the form, then the profile is updated.
Given a duplicate username, when the user submits it, then validation errors are displayed.
Given a server error, when the update fails, then the previous username remains in place.

title: Change email address
description: As a user, I want to change my email address so that my account uses an up-to-date contact address.
constraints: The new email address must be valid and unique.
The change may require re-verification before activation.
A confirmation message must be sent to the new address.
The previous email must remain active until the change is confirmed.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a valid new email, when the user submits the change, then a confirmation process starts.
Given an invalid or already used email, when the form is submitted, then validation errors are shown.
Given an unconfirmed email change, when the user logs in later, then the account still uses the old address until verified.

title: Manage devices
description: As a user, I want to manage my connected devices so that I can review and revoke active sessions.
constraints: Each device entry must show the last active date and location if available.
The user must be able to revoke a single device session.
Revoking the current session must require special handling.
The list must be limited to the current user.
acceptanceCriteria: Given several devices, when the user opens device management, then the active sessions are listed.
Given a device is revoked, when the user confirms the action, then that session is invalidated.
Given the current device is revoked, when the action is accepted, then the user is logged out.

title: View billing summary
description: As a customer, I want to view my billing summary so that I can understand my charges.
constraints: The summary must show totals, taxes, and billing period.
Only the current customer's data may be displayed.
A loading state must appear while the summary is retrieved.
The page must handle missing billing data gracefully.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a valid account, when the user opens billing summary, then the totals are shown.
Given no billing records, when the page loads, then an empty or informational state is displayed.
Given an unauthorized user, when they access the page, then access is blocked.

title: Download receipt
description: As a customer, I want to download a receipt so that I can keep proof of payment.
constraints: The receipt must be generated only for completed payments.
The file must contain the payment reference and amount.
The download link must expire after a limited duration.
The document must not expose sensitive card data.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a completed payment, when the user requests a receipt, then the file is generated.
Given a pending payment, when the user requests a receipt, then the action is unavailable.
Given an expired link, when it is used, then access is denied.

title: Request support
description: As a user, I want to contact support so that I can report an issue or ask a question.
constraints: A subject and message must be required.
The request must include the user's account context if they are logged in.
Spam protection must be applied.
A confirmation message must be displayed after submission.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a valid support form, when the user submits it, then the request is created.
Given missing required fields, when the form is submitted, then validation errors are displayed.
Given a spam-like submission, when the request is sent, then it is rejected or flagged.
